summary: This plugin wraps the DSH web interface in a local Electron desktop app, letting users launch it from the DSH UI, a desktop shortcut, or the command line while managing the local dsh web service as needed.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily a desktop-wrapper utility for users of the DSH web GUI, as shown by its name, description, and README, which describe an Electron-based native windowed client that embeds the web interface while hiding browser UI and backend command details. It additionally includes local process lifecycle features (single-instance windows, tray behavior, hidden bootstrap/startup of the dsh web backend, and multiple launch entry points), matching a user-facing desktop application purpose.
